data:
Zwei Mädchen müssen umziehen und kommen in eine neue Schule, die "Stage and Performance School Kiel". Milla (Joyce Hildebrand) lebte vorher auf dem Lande und Elena (Diana-Maria Krieger) in Russland. Etwas Entscheidendes haben beide Mädchen gemeinsam: Jedes von ihnen fürchtet sich vor seinem ersten Tag an der Schule. Für Elena scheint die Sorge auch zunächst völlig berechtigt – sie wird aufgrund ihrer eigenartigen Kleidung gemobbt. Milla hingegen hat mehr Glück, ihre Klasse nimmt sie besser auf. Obwohl die zwei jungen Damen also auf unterschiedlichen Hierarchiestufen stehen, freunden sich Milla und Elena an und werden schließlich sogar beste Freundinnen. Es könnte so schön sein – doch dann passiert etwas, das noch in die stärkste Mädelsfreundschaft einen Keil getrieben hat: Die beiden verlieben sich in denselben Jungen. Finden Milla und Elena einen Weg, trotzdem Freundinnen zu bleiben? (Two girls have to move to a new school, the “Stage and Performance School Kiel”. Milla (Joyce Hildebrand) previously lived in the country and Elena (Diana-Maria Krieger) in Russia. Both girls have something crucial in common: each of them dreads their first day at the school. For Elena, the worry seems completely justified at first - she is bullied because of her strange clothes. Milla, on the other hand, is luckier, her class accepts her better. Although the two young ladies are on different levels of the hierarchy, Milla and Elena become friends and eventually even best friends. It could be so nice - but then something happens that drives a wedge into even the strongest of girl friendships: The two fall in love with the same boy. Will Milla and Elena find a way to remain friends anyway?

Two girls have to move to a new school, the “Stage and Performance School Kiel”. Milla (Joyce Hildebrand) previously lived in the country and Elena (Diana-Maria Krieger) in Russia. Both girls have something crucial in common: each of them dreads their first day at the school. For Elena, the worry seems completely justified at first - she is bullied because of her strange clothes. Milla, on the other hand, is luckier, her class accepts her better. Although the two young ladies are on different levels of the hierarchy, Milla and Elena become friends and eventually even best friends. It could be so nice - but then something happens that drives a wedge into even the strongest of girl friendships: The two fall in love with the same boy. Will Milla and Elena find a way to remain friends anyway?
